header.title: PGM XIb: Magical formulas ("table gimmick" to let appear drunken people of a symposion to others to have donkey snouts): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Papyri Graecae Magicae
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64086:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.10: Badly damaged. Line 10 has letters deleted by the scribe and an unread word ending -πειν; line 11 is a fragment. ‘Has mounted’ assumes [ἐπι]βεβηκότος and is doubtful. δρεῖλλον (‘drillon’) is unclear, perhaps δρῖλος, ‘penis’. Spellings: πείνοντας/πείνωσι for πίνοντας/πίνουσι, συμποσέιῳ for συμποσίῳ, ἐλλύχνει for ἐλλύχνιον, λύχον for λύχνον.

nodes.text: [...] ...pein new, and ... it, and set it under
[afa]r, to those outside, to appear donkey-snouted:
[...] of [one that] has mounted (?), the *drillon* from the gore
[...] with an ass’s [...] to smear with blood, and to make a new wick
[fo]r a new lamp, and to light it for the drinkers.
